Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery call - GDPR, DPA & SCC selection

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Agreement on scope: AcmeHealth will act as Controller; Redwood will process customer-provided data to provide inference services.
- Compliance items you asked us to provide: Redwood SOC 2 report, our standard DPA, and recommended SCC approach for EU transfers.
- Next steps for procurement:
  1) We'll send a draft DPA + SCC recommendation for your legal team to review.
  2) Please confirm whether you prefer Controller-to-Processor standard SCCs (the typical Controller -> Processor module) or if you have a preferred template.
  3) We'll also provision the vendor security questionnaire (we can share a short form now and a full questionnaire if needed) and a link for secure upload of any requested evidence.

I've attached our DPA template and a short vendor questionnaire stub to this thread.

Are you able to confirm the SCC module preference and a target date for procurement signature? We're aiming to have paperwork started this week to keep the timeline for the pilot.

Thanks,

Rishi
Senior Account Executive

- SCC preference: Our procurement/legal team prefers the standard Controller-to-Processor SCCs (Controller -> Processor module). If you can provide the wording that maps to that flow, that will speed review.
- Timeline: Procurement is targeting signature by the end of next week (we have an internal review window).

Rishi / Neha,

Thanks for the heads up. Based on AcmeHealth confirming Controller role, recommended approach:

- Use our standard Data Processing Addendum (attached) with the Controller-to-Processor SCC appendix. That maps to the common Controller -> Processor flow that procurement asked for.
- We'll include the SCC text as an annex (module: Controller-to-Processor) instead of inline amendments to keep signatures clean.
- Request DocuSign execution; procurement teams prefer that for auditability.
- Ask AcmeHealth to confirm any special data retention or deletion requirements (beyond our standard DPA) so we can call those out.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_v1.docx (with SCC annex placeholder). I also created a DocuSign envelope to speed things up: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-ENVELOPE-ID

If procurement pushes for any unusual clause, send it to legal and we can handle redlines.

Marissa
